title: [v1.80.1 Release 3394] External programs do not work anymore
author: judaspriest
body_snippet:
In production, I currently use the oldstable release "v1.80.1 Release 3394"

The oldstable version "v1.80.1 Release 3394" has a problem with external programs.

I want to open "Shared Folders", which are part of my connections. For that reason I created an external program:

Name = Shared Folders
File Name = ‪C:\Windows\System32\fsmgmt.msc
Parameter = /Computer=%HOSTNAME%
Workding directory = [empty]

Options: None of the 4 options is enabled

comments.snippet:
Update: It seems that this affects only "some" internal Windows applications / executables , like "Ms Edge" oder "*.msc" programs.

cmd.exe, explorer.exe, powershell.exe and external executables like KeePass.exe, Firefox.exe are not affected.


As a workaround for Windows internal applications, the following can be helpful:

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the detailed analysis and the workaround @judaspriest!

**Two issues identified and fixed:**

1. **Edge / paths with parentheses:** Our security validation was rejecting `(` and `)` as dangerous shell metacharacters, which blocked `C:\Program Files (x86)\...` — one of the most common Windows paths. Parentheses are now allowed since they're harmless in `Process.Start`.
